Lupin Q2 results: Net profit falls 22% to ₹1,155 cr, revenue at ₹7,827 cr
items.summary:
Homegrown pharma major Lupin on Wednesday posted a 22.19 per cent decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 1,155.30 crore in the September quarter, dragged down by an exceptional item.
The company had posted a net profit of Rs 1,484.83 crore in the corresponding period of the previous fiscal year, it said in a regulatory filing to the exchanges.
Revenue from operations was Rs 7,827.26 crore during the quarter under review, up from Rs 7,047.51 crore in the year-ago period, it said.
Lupin's total expenses also rose to Rs 6,374.46 crore during the quarter from Rs 5,130.54 crore in the same period last year.
During the April-September period in FY27, Lupin's net profit declined 4.95 per cent to Rs 2,572.28 crore from Rs 2,706.29 crore a year earlier, the filing said.
During the six months ended September 30, 2026, Lupin Pharmaceuticals Inc USA, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Group, settled one of the ongoing antitrust matters for Rs 316.28 crore (USD 35.8 million) without admission

Zydus Lifesciences on Wednesday posted a 26.6 per cent decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 925.5 crore in the September quarter weighed down by an increase in expenses.
The company had posted a net profit of Rs 1,260.9 crore in the corresponding period of the previous fiscal year, it said in a regulatory filing to the exchanges.
Revenue from operations rose to Rs 7,909.6 crore during the quarter under review from Rs 6,123.2 crore in the year-ago period, it said.
Zydus' total expenses rose sharply to Rs 6,806.6 crore during the quarter from Rs 4,509 crore in the same period last year.
During the quarter, pharma business contributed to 83 per cent of Zydus' sales, the company said in a media release.

items.title: Puravankara Q2 results: Net profit at ₹84 cr, income rises to ₹1,051 cr
items.summary:
Realty firm Puravankara Ltd has reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 83.74 crore for the quarter ended September on higher revenue. Bengaluru-based Puravankara Ltd had posted a net loss of Rs 42.99 crore in the year-ago period.
Total income rose to Rs 1,051.02 crore in the second quarter of this fiscal, from Rs 662.73 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding year, according to a regulatory filing.
During the first half of this fiscal, the company posted a net profit of Rs 107.24 crore as against a net loss of Rs 111.42 crore in the year-ago period.
Total income surged to Rs 1,928.17 crore in the April-September period of 2026-27 fiscal from Rs 1,201.37 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding year.

items.summary:
Realty firm Puravankara Ltd has reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 83.74 crore for the quarter ended September on higher revenue. Bengaluru-based Puravankara Ltd had posted a net loss of Rs 42.99 crore in the year-ago period.
Total income rose to Rs 1,051.02 crore in the second quarter of this fiscal, from Rs 662.73 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding year, according to a regulatory filing.
During the first half of this fiscal, the company posted a net profit of Rs 107.24 crore as against a net loss of Rs 111.42 crore in the year-ago period.
Total income surged to Rs 1,928.17 crore in the April-September period of 2026-27 fiscal from Rs 1,201.37 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding year.
Ashish Puravankara, Managing Director, Puravankara, said, "Our Q2, FY27 performance reflects the progress we are making in converting execution into revenue and earnings. Higher handovers, sustained sales and stronger realisations supported the quarter's growth, .

Bajaj Auto's total sales during October rise 14% to 591,876 units
items.summary:
Bajaj Auto on Monday posted a 14 per cent year-on-year growth in its total sales during October, with double-digit growth across two-wheelers and commercial vehicles.
The automaker's total wholesales stood at 5,91,876 units, against 5,18,170 units in the year-ago period, according to an exchange filing.
Domestic sales rose 12 per cent to 3,51,148 units, while exports grew 18 per cent to 2,40,728 units.
Total two-wheeler sales increased by 13 per cent to 5,01,194 units from 4,42,316 in the year-ago period.
Total commercial vehicle sales were higher by 20 per cent to 90,682 units, compared to 75,854 units.
Bajaj Auto's total sales during the April-October period rose 22 per cent to 35,79,011 units.
Two-wheeler sales rose 22 per cent to 30,07,707 units, while commercial vehicle sales were higher by 23 per cent at 5,71,304 units.

'Nobody will trust you...': SC junks Centre's plea against Vedanta arbitration awards
items.summary: The Supreme Court dismissed the Union government's appeal concerning disputes involving $99 million arbitral awards. Vedanta and Ravva Oil sought the enforcement of these awards related to the Ravva oilfield. The Delhi High Court had previously rejected the government's objections to enforcing the awards. The disputes originated from a 1994 production sharing contract between the petroleum ministry and various companies.
